_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/counters/test_counter_replacement_put_by.py. t_pb_talent is Innkeeper's Talent's level-3 line as a plain enchantment: keyed on who puts the counters, every permanent and every player. t_pb_venom is a sorcery giving target opponent two poison counters; t_pb_graft puts a +1/+1 counter on any target creature.

cards.name: Test Putter's Talent
cards.oracle_text: If you would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, put twice that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead.

abilities.text: If you would put one or more counters on a permanent or player, put twice that many of each of those kinds of counters on that permanent or player instead.

cards.name: Test Venom
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent gets two poison counters.

cards.name: Test Graft
cards.oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
